title: CPR Rescue Breathing
description: Walks through the adult CPR sequence step by step, hands-only CPR, and how child and infant CPR differ. Covers choking victims who become unresponsive, drowning, hypothermia, pregnancy, and trauma cases, switching rescuers, and when to stop.
shortDescription: Step-by-step adult, child, and infant CPR, hands-only CPR, and when to stop
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
